label: Wet-dry cycling
description: Cycle number and length, wet and dry phase temperatures, durations and humidity of wet-dry cycling experiments (a step that runs only for wet-dry experiments); rows per cycle with cumulative times.

variable_categories.label: Wet-Dry Cycling
variable_categories.description: the cycles of wet-dry experiments: cycle number and length, wet and dry phase temperatures, durations and humidity

row_rules: Wet-dry cycling experiments: one row per cycle sampled, in a set of type "Evaporation Cycle"; name each row by its cycle ('Cycle 3').
For wet-dry cycles the duration (`hr`) is the TOTAL time up to the end of that cycle: 24 h cycles -> Cycle 1 = 24, Cycle 2 = 48, Cycle 3 = 72 (cycles of different lengths add up).
